examples.en: For every one or two talented people in any group of artists, there are hordes of talentless hangers-on.
examples.zh: 在任何一个艺术家圈子里，每一两位有才华的人身边儿总会有一帮无能的阿谀奉承者。

examples.en: Carmen figures out a way to steal musical talent and transfers it to her two talentless henchwomen.
examples.zh: 卡门想出了一个方法偷取音乐才能然后把它输送给两个无能的人。

examples.en: NPC B: Killers on the loose, rookies to train, and now a talentless hack of a sketch artist who can't draw a face!
examples.zh: 凶手逍遥法外，新人经验不足，现在又多了一个连张脸都画不好的草包素描画师！
